title: Component inventory, ObjectStack integration roadmap, and AI development prompts
body:
Establishes baseline component inventory (72 total, 58 complete), 8-week development plan for ObjectStack client integration, and comprehensive AI development prompts for each core component.

## Component Inventory

Created comprehensive documentation (COMPONENT_INVENTORY.md) covering:

- **9 core categories**: Basic (7), Form (15), Layout (9), Data Display (6), Complex (10), Navigation (2), Overlay (9), Feedback (4), Disclosure (2)
- **5 plugin packages**: Charts (3), Editor (1), Kanban (1), Markdown (1), Object (2)
- **ObjectStack integration status**: ✅ Adapter operational, 🔴 UI components need integration

## AI Development Prompts

Created AI_DEVELOPMENT_PROMPTS.md with detailed prompts for AI-assisted component development:

- **15+ component prompts** covering all categories (Basic, Form, Layout, Data Display, Complex, Plugins)
- **Structured format** for each component: Requirements, Props, Implementation guidelines, Example schemas, Test cases
- **ObjectStack integration patterns** for data-driven components (DataTable, ObjectTable, ObjectForm, FilterBuilder, Kanban)
- **Implementation best practices** including component structure templates and testing patterns
- **Ready-to-use prompts** for AI assistants to accelerate component development

Each prompt provides complete guidance on building components with Shadcn/UI, Tailwind CSS, and ObjectStack integration.

## Critical Gaps

| Component | Gap | Impact |
|-----------|-----|--------|
| ObjectTable/ObjectForm | No metadata-driven UI generation | 🔴 Flagship components blocked |
| Filter Builder | No FilterNode AST conversion | 🔴 Query filtering non-functional |
| Kanban | No CRUD/state persistence | 🔴 Popular component incomplete |
| File Upload | No storage backend | 🟡 Common use case missing |
| Chart | Static data only | 🟡 Dashboard utility limited |
| Tree View | No hierarchical queries | 🟡 Organizational data unsupported |

## 8-Week Priority Plan

**Phase 1 (Weeks 1-4)**: Critical ObjectStack Integration
- Metadata → UI generation (ObjectTable, ObjectForm)
- Filter UI → FilterNode AST (Filter Builder)
- Full CRUD + drag-drop persistence (Kanban)

**Phase 2 (Weeks 5-6)**: High Priority
- File storage adapter integration
- Chart data binding to ObjectStack queries
- Tree View hierarchical query support

**Phase 3 (Weeks 7-8)**: Quality & Documentation
- Test coverage to 85%+
- Showcase examples
- Integration guides

## ObjectStackAdapter Status

Already operational with:
```typescript
import { createObjectStackAdapter } from '@object-ui/core';

const dataSource = createObjectStackAdapter({
  baseUrl: process.env.API_URL,
  token: process.env.API_TOKEN
});

// Full CRUD operational
await dataSource.find('users', {
  $filter: { status: 'active', age: { $gte: 18 } }, // Auto-converts to FilterNode AST
  $orderby: { createdAt: 'desc' },
  $top: 20
});
```

Next step: wire components to leverage this adapter for metadata-driven UI generation using the AI development prompts as guidance.
